Name: Disable Key Vault Public Network Access
Description: The Key Vault allows access through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private endpoints or an approved restricted network design.
ImpactWarning: Applications and users accessing the vault through its public endpoint may lose connectivity. Verify private endpoint connectivity, DNS and network configuration before applying.

Name: Remove Broad Inbound NSG Rule
Description: The Network Security Group contains an inbound allow rule permitting internet traffic across a broad range of ports. Remove the offending rule or replace it with a narrowly scoped rule.
ImpactWarning: Deleting the rule may interrupt legitimate inbound connectivity. Identify the exact offending rule and review dependent applications before applying.

Name: Remove Unrestricted Internet NSG Rule
Description: The Network Security Group contains an inbound allow rule permitting unrestricted internet access to any destination port. Remove the offending rule or replace it with restricted source and destination ranges.
ImpactWarning: Deleting the rule can interrupt application connectivity. Confirm the exact rule and required inbound traffic before applying.

Name: Remove Unrestricted SQL Firewall Rule
Description: The Azure SQL Server has a firewall rule allowing connections from any IPv4 address. Remove the unrestricted firewall rule.
ImpactWarning: Deleting the firewall rule can interrupt database connectivity. Confirm the exact rule and ensure trusted clients have alternative access before applying.

Name: Disable SQL Server Public Network Access
Description: The Azure SQL Server allows connections through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private connectivity.
ImpactWarning: Applications and clients using the public endpoint may lose connectivity. Verify private endpoints, DNS and application connectivity before applying.

Name: Disable Storage Account Public Network Access
Description: The Storage Account allows access through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private endpoints or approved restricted network access.
ImpactWarning: Applications and services using the public endpoint may lose connectivity. Verify private endpoints, DNS and application dependencies before applying.

Name: Associate Network Security Group with Subnet
Description: The subnet does not have an associated Network Security Group. Associate an existing NSG to control inbound and outbound network traffic.
ImpactWarning: Associating an NSG changes subnet traffic filtering. Review existing security rules and verify required application connectivity before applying.
